thread:
sara_sales: Heads-up — FinReg asked if we can run a week-long POC where all inference and keys stay in EU (and optionally APAC) and no cross-border egress. They need subprocessor list, KMS options per region, and an egress cost estimate before legal signs off.

mike_infra: quick q — is this hosted or dedicated for the POC?

sara_sales: started as hosted to move fast but they're open to Dedicated if hosted can't meet residency/KMS needs.

mike_infra: hosted supports EU-only routing via regional endpoints. We have customer-side KMS for Private/Private-Hosted? Not for hosted public yet. For hosted we use our KMS in region but keys are multiregion-backed.

elen_security: clarifying: they require customer-managed keys in-region (no cross-region key replication) and full subprocessor disclosure. That rules out our default hosted key setup unless we do a temporary Dedicated or Private deployment.

rahul_se: For a short POC we could spin a Dedicated pool in eu-west1 and ap-southeast1. That gives per-region KMS integration (we can attach customer KMS per pool). Ops will need ~72 hrs to provision; cost estimate depends on GPU hours.

mike_infra: also note: routing_policy can be configured to prefer region then failover. Example config: `routing_policy: [ {region: eu, failover: none}, {region: apac, failover: none} ]` If they want strict no-failover across borders we need a per-tenant pin to region + deny fallback.

elen_security: subprocessor list: legal wants the full vendor list including cloud infra (GCP EU regions), observability providers, and any analytics SaaS. I can provide the current CSV but will need time to redact contact emails.

sara_sales: customer also wants egress pricing delta between: a) EU-only hosted with our standard subprocessor scope, b) Dedicated pinned to EU with customer KMS, c) Private self-hosted (their infra). Can someone give a ballpark per-1M tokens egress delta?

mike_infra: ballpark: hosted EU-only: base egress $0.02/1k tokens + infra overhead, Dedicated (pinned+KMS): add $0.01-0.03/1k tokens due to reserved capacity and KMS HSM calls, Private: variable — no egress to us but ops+networking costs on their side. I'll formalize numbers.

rahul_se: note: KMS HSM requests can add latencies ~10-50ms per session if using on-call key unwraps. For token-heavy workloads we recommend envelope encryption + ephemeral session keys cached on nodes. Ops to confirm caching TTL.

ops-bot: deploy request received: dedicated-poc-eu (eta 72h). Ticket #P-3421.

mike_infra: Ops flagged: we need customer KMS provider details (GCP KMS / AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault) + billing contact. Also confirm if they want bring-your-own-certs for TLS to satisfy audit.

sara_sales: I'll ask FinReg for KMS provider, certs, and whether they want no-fallback routing. Also share the subprocessor CSV and a short cost delta note back by EOD.

elen_security: I'll start pulling the subproc inventory and highlight any non-EU data processors (should be minimal). Expect initial doc in 24h.

rahul_se: I'll draft a one-page POC runbook: objectives, success criteria (no cross-border egress, KMS OK, <150ms p95), provisioning steps, and rollback. Will drop link when ready.

sara_sales: perfect. tagging next steps: @elen_security subproc CSV, @mike_infra firm pricing + perf caveats, @rahul_se POC runbook. I'll coordinate with FinReg and get SOC/ISO questions. :thumbsup:

mike_infra: FYI — if they insist on strict in-region KMS with zero replication, hosted isn't an option today. Dedicated or Private it is.

sara_sales: noted. thanks all — I'll update thread after customer reply.
